How to choose

Two questions decide it for you

1. Have you done this before?

Every course here starts at the beginning and assumes no prior security knowledge. You do not need to finish one course before starting another.

2. What do you want to be able to do?

Read the outcome list on each course. If those outcomes describe work you want to do, that is the course to take.

How a course is organised

Each course is split into modules. Each module has one clear goal, and each lesson is short enough to finish in one sitting. You can leave and come back: your progress is stored on this device only, with no account.
